analysis: The Cori cycle involves the conversion of lactate produced in skeletal muscles during anaerobic glycolysis into glucose in the liver. This process helps in maintaining blood glucose levels and provides energy during intense exercise. Lactate is transported to the liver, where it is converted back into pyruvate and then into glucose through gluconeogenesis.
